request: Add to Streak a command listGoals, titled "List goals", on Cmd+Shift+G (mod+shift+g), that puts in state.goals one text per measurable habit, in list order, as "Run: 15 km" (its name, target and unit). Write it in Lisp, with its key, in the program's habits.lisp.

add./program/habits.lisp/listGoals:
(defcommand listGoals "Keeps each measurable habit's goal in state.goals." :title "List goals" :category "View"
  []
  (set "state.goals"
       (map (fn [habit] (str (:name habit) ": " (:target habit) " " (:unit habit)))
            (filter (fn [habit] (= (:kind habit) "measurable")) data.ordered))))
